rationale: The same device binding sourcePicker in stable v1.81.0 opens automatically on virtual-to-HA and lacks a transient Escape registration. This fixes an existing stable workflow, not the new icon state-source feature in the 1.82 beta line.

summary.ru: Список HA-устройств открывается только по нажатию и закрывается по Escape без потери черновика.
summary.en: The HA device list opens only on request and closes with Escape without losing the draft.
